findings.highlight: I cannot go anywhere as I have work today.
findings.evidenceJa: 今日はバイトが入っているので寄り道はできない。
findings.governingReading: Because he has a shift today, Shirou cannot make any detours and must go directly to the neighboring district.
findings.explanation: Cannot go anywhere says he cannot leave or travel at all, contradicting the next sentence’s required destination instead of excluding side trips.
